steps.title: Analyze Build Failure
steps.description: Inspected the build logs and identified that the AAPT compiler failed due to an invalid layout attribute value.

steps.title: Identify Resource Error
steps.description: Pinpointed the incorrect layout_width and layout_height value 'match_size' inside activity_login.xml.

steps.title: Correct Layout Attributes
steps.description: Changed layout_width and layout_height attributes from 'match_size' to 'match_parent' in activity_login.xml to resolve the resource linking failure.

steps.title: Validate All Layout Files
steps.description: Scanned all other layout resources to guarantee there are no other occurrences of invalid XML attributes.

steps.title: Validate Gradle Dependencies
steps.description: Verified build configurations, compile SDK versions, and compatibility structures.

steps.title: Validate Backend Dynamic Integrations
steps.description: Ensured the api_schema.json collections and logic expressions match the app expectations.

steps.title: Confirm Offline Calculations
steps.description: Ensured calculations such as total income, total expense, and balance persist correctly locally in Java code.

steps.title: Verify Authentication Routines
steps.description: Assured register, login, and Gmail OTP reset workflows function securely.

steps.title: Review Java Class Code Integration
steps.description: Confirmed BackendApi and all activity classes reference UI elements properly after layout corrections.

steps.title: Building Expense Tracker
steps.description: Re-run the gradle build commands to assemble the final safe release version.
